_comment: Group-membership protocol mapper for the rag-ui client. POST to /admin/realms/<realm>/clients/<rag-ui-uuid>/protocol-mappers/models. Adds a 'groups' claim to the access token (a flat list of group names) so the agent's group grants resolve (auth.token_validator.extract_groups + the group#member viewer tuples). full.path=false emits 'finance' not '/finance'; extract_groups also strips a leading '/' either way. Pair with agent GROUPS_CLAIM=groups (default).
name: groups
